evidence.model_evidence: The supplied live retrieval evidence consists of Bing search results for site-restricted queries targeting German job boards (arbeitsagentur.de, stepstone.de, adzuna.de, arbeitnow.com, germantechjobs.de, eurotechjobs.com, remotive.com, hitmarker.net). The returned results are generic web pages, Wikipedia articles, or broad category landing pages (e.g., StepStone software tester general list) without any specific direct QA/test vacancy cards, detailed job postings, or live API/listing payloads for Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany-wide remote. Consequently, no new sources meet the criteria for verification, and no additions are made.
